policy.name: Vitamin D Testing (25-Hydroxyvitamin D and 1,25-Dihydroxyvitamin D)
policy.text:
Policy: Vitamin D Testing (25-Hydroxyvitamin D and 1,25-Dihydroxyvitamin D)
Policy Number: LAB-0042
Effective Date: 2025-01-01

CPT codes addressed:
- 82306  Vitamin D; 25 hydroxy
- 82652  Vitamin D; 1,25 dihydroxy

Coverage Indications
Testing for 25-hydroxyvitamin D (CPT 82306) is considered medically necessary when ordered for a patient with one of the following conditions:
- Chronic kidney disease (N18.x)
- Osteoporosis (M81.0)
- Osteomalacia (M83.x)
- Vitamin D deficiency (E55.9)
- Malabsorption syndromes, including celiac disease (K90.0) and Crohn's disease (K50.x)
- Chronic liver disease (K70 through K77)
- Hypocalcemia (E83.51) or hypercalcemia (E83.52)

Frequency Limitations
For monitoring of patients with an established covered diagnosis, testing of 25-hydroxyvitamin D is limited to once every 12 months.
Exception: For patients with malabsorption syndromes, or who are undergoing active repletion therapy for documented vitamin D deficiency, testing may be performed up to once every 3 months.

Non-Covered Indications
Routine screening of asymptomatic patients without a covered diagnosis is not covered. This includes general wellness or preventive encounters (for example, Z00.00).
Testing for 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D (CPT 82652) is non-covered except for patients with chronic kidney disease (N18.x) or hypercalcemia (E83.52).

frequency_limit.applies_to: patients with an established covered diagnosis receiving monitoring of 25-hydroxyvitamin D

exceptions: patients undergoing active repletion therapy for documented vitamin D deficiency
rules.decision_logic: APPROVE CPT 82306 when billed with a covered diagnosis; otherwise DENY, subject to the stated monitoring frequency limits and exceptions.
rules.source_reference: Coverage Indications / Frequency Limitations: "Testing for 25-hydroxyvitamin D (CPT 82306) is considered medically necessary" and "limited to once every 12 months"

frequency_limit.applies_to: patients with malabsorption syndromes or active repletion therapy for documented vitamin D deficiency

rules.decision_logic: APPROVE CPT 82306 up to once every 3 months when the patient has a malabsorption syndrome or is undergoing active repletion therapy for documented vitamin D deficiency; otherwise DENY if the frequency exceeds this limit.
rules.source_reference: Frequency Limitations: "Exception: For patients with malabsorption syndromes, or who are undergoing active repletion therapy for documented vitamin D deficiency, testing may be performed up to once every 3 months"

frequency_limit.applies_to: routine screening or preventive testing without a covered diagnosis

rules.decision_logic: DENY CPT 82306 when ordered as routine screening of an asymptomatic patient without a covered diagnosis, including general wellness or preventive encounters.
rules.source_reference: Non-Covered Indications: "Routine screening of asymptomatic patients without a covered diagnosis is not covered" and "for example, Z00.00"

rules.decision_logic: APPROVE CPT 82652 only when the patient has chronic kidney disease or hypercalcemia; otherwise DENY.
rules.source_reference: Non-Covered Indications: "Testing for 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D (CPT 82652) is non-covered except for patients with chronic kidney disease (N18.x) or hypercalcemia (E83.52)"
